gameLoop: Work a 6x4 field: plant turnip or pumpkin seeds, water every growth stage, harvest ripe crops for coins, and bank 500 coins to win.

obstacles.role: each growth stage needs watering before it grows
seeds cost coins; pumpkins pay best but tie up plots longest

collectibles: Harvest payouts: 12 coins per turnip, 55 per pumpkin.
progression: Day cycle: 60-second days; morning rain may water thirsty plots.
scoring: Coins from harvests; banked total persists as the local best.
loseCondition: None: endless cozy farming until the goal is banked.
notes: Demo blueprint for the farming template.
